papers.title: Regulation of neuronal input transformations by tunable dendritic inhibition.

pipeline_steps.technique: Multicompartmental biophysical simulation of a CA1 pyramidal cell with distributed excitatory (AMPA/NMDA) synapses and conductance-based inhibition, used to model the effect of disinhibiting perisomatic or dendrite-targeting interneuron populations

parameters.cell_geometry_and_conductances: same CA1 cell geometry/channel conductances as Poirazi et al. 2003
parameters.excitatory_synapse_placement: AMPA+NMDA conductances distributed across strata oriens and radiatum, spatial distribution proportional to measured anatomical density
parameters.excitatory_activation: Poisson process, rate tuned to produce ~450 pA somatic current under voltage clamp without inhibition
parameters.inhibition_model: constant conductance, reversal potential -75 mV, conductance proportional to anatomically measured inhibitory synapse density x measured interneuron firing rate
parameters.disinhibition_model: increased conductance of one interneuron population as the antagonistic population is silenced

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated CA1 pyramidal cell somatic voltage/firing responses under varying inhibitory conditions

papers.title: Septo-hippocampal GABAergic signaling across multiple modalities in awake mice.

pipeline_steps.technique: Design and integration of a resonant-scanning two-photon imaging acquisition system for dual-channel (GCaMP/tdTomato) calcium imaging in awake, head-fixed mice

parameters.excitation_laser: Chameleon Ultra II (Coherent), 920 nm, 20-40 mW average power at back focal plane
parameters.detectors: GaAsP PMT (Hamamatsu 7422P-40, green GCaMP); multi-alkali PMT (Hamamatsu R3896, red tdTomato)
parameters.frame_size_and_fov: 256x128 pixels; 165x165 um or 117x117 um field of view

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: dual-channel (red/green) raw two-photon time-series images
pipeline_steps.hardware: Ultima in vivo multiphoton microscopy system (Prairie Technologies)

pipeline_steps.technique: Design of a microcontroller-driven behavioral apparatus for multi-modal stimulus presentation and locomotor tracking, synchronized with two-photon imaging

parameters.visual_stimulus: 200 ms light flash via red LED
parameters.locomotion_sensor: infrared LED / phototransistor treadmill wheel encoder
parameters.synchronization: NI USB-6229 DAQPAD (National Instruments), common trigger pulse shared with two-photon imaging

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: synchronized behavioral/stimulus event traces and locomotion voltage signal

pipeline_steps.technique: Two-step motion correction: frame-by-frame rigid alignment by spatial cross-correlation, followed by a row-by-row Hidden Markov Model correcting within-frame (intra-scan) motion artifacts

parameters.step1_frame_alignment: maximize spatial cross-correlation between each frame and a running template averaged from previously aligned frames
parameters.step2_hmm: first-order autoregressive (AR1) model of brain displacement per row-acquisition-time; Poisson photon-noise model for pixel intensity; MAP displacement estimated via the Viterbi algorithm
parameters.channel_combination: product of per-channel observation likelihoods, assuming independent noise across channels
parameters.exclusion_criterion: frames with manually confirmed uncorrected out-of-plane motion discarded
parameters.gain_estimation_subset: estimated using only the 10% of pixel locations with smallest spatial intensity-gradient magnitude, from frames sharing the same estimated displacement as their neighbors

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: motion-corrected two-photon time-series

pipeline_steps.technique: Channel separation of mixed GCaMP and tdTomato signals via independent component analysis (ICA) applied to time-averaged motion-corrected images

parameters.noise_reduction: GCaMP channel denoised by subtracting the time-averaged (not per-frame) red tdTomato channel, justified by the static tdTomato signal

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: channel-separated (unmixed) GCaMP and tdTomato signal images

pipeline_steps.technique: Manual ROI selection on time-averaged, motion-corrected, channel-separated images with per-frame fluorescence signal extracted as the intensity-weighted average within each ROI

parameters.signal_definition: intensity-weighted average of pixel values within each ROI at each imaging frame
parameters.exclusion_criterion: boutons not present in the field of view for all imaging frames were discarded

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-ROI (per-bouton) raw fluorescence time series

pipeline_steps.technique: Offset principal component analysis (oPCA): a PCA variant using a lag-1 (time-offset) cross-product covariance estimator to denoise extracted bouton signals under an independent-photon-noise assumption, retaining only the components needed to capture the full estimated signal variance

parameters.estimator: lag-1 cross-product covariance estimator, unbiased under independent photon noise and slow signal dynamics relative to imaging rate
parameters.component_retention_rule: minimal number of oPCs whose cumulative estimated relative power sums to 1 (100% of estimated signal variance)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: denoised bouton signals reconstructed from retained oPCA components

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantification of stimulus-evoked and running-related calcium responses by integrating dF/F over defined post-stimulus/running windows relative to a pre-event baseline, with per-trial significance assessed by a Z-test

parameters.running_baseline: average signal during periods without running
parameters.exclusions: trials with running excluded from stimulus-response analysis; first 5 s after each stimulus excluded from running-response analysis
parameters.intensity_dependence_inclusion: boutons with a significant response to the strongest stimulus

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: per-bouton stimulus- and running-evoked response magnitudes and significance calls

pipeline_steps.technique: Quantification of similarity between each bouton's running-response and stimulus-response as the angle between per-bouton response vectors across the population, compared against a shuffled-identity null distribution

parameters.pharmacology_inclusion_criterion: boutons with significant (P<0.05) and substantial (mean > 0.4 s.dF/F) responses under control or drug conditions
parameters.null_model: angle recalculated after random permutation of bouton identity

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-bouton running-response and stimulus-response magnitude vectors
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: population-level running-vs-stimulus response angle metric and shuffled null distribution

pipeline_steps.technique: General hypothesis-testing procedure: two-sided comparisons throughout, with a shuffle-test framework for population-level comparisons computing empirical P values

parameters.shuffle_test_p_value_rule: twice the smaller of the two tail fractions (fraction of shuffles below vs. above the true mean)
parameters.shuffled_identity_types: bouton identity, axon identity, or postsynaptic target identity
parameters.blinding: data collection and analysis not performed blind to experimental condition
parameters.sample_size_determination: no a priori statistical power analysis; sample sizes matched to prior publications

pipeline_steps.source_quote: No statistical test was used to determine sample size a priori

papers.title: Dendritic inhibition in the hippocampus supports fear learning.
Mnemonic Functions for Nonlinear Dendritic Integration in Hippocampal Pyramidal Circuits.

pipeline_steps.technique: Numerical simulation, integration, and visualization of a two-compartment recurrent-network model of hippocampal memory encoding
Simulated memory encoding via random Bernoulli-distributed initial recurrent synaptic weights followed by a stochastic Hebbian weight-update rule applied after each input pattern presentation

parameters.initial_weight_distribution: Bernoulli (0 or 1), mean equal to equilibrium fraction of potentiated synapses

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: simulated recurrent synaptic weight matrix

pipeline_steps.technique: Generation of tuned distal and proximal input activation patterns for model neurons using thresholded von Mises-distributed random inputs, with input similarity across simulated environments controlled by the distribution's concentration parameter
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: binary distal and proximal input activation patterns per model neuron

pipeline_steps.technique: Calculation of recurrence frequency (probability a neuron recurs in engrams for similar memories) for both one-compartment and two-compartment model variants
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: recurrence frequency probability density (Figure 5C)

pipeline_steps.technique: Calculation of correlation between simulated engrams, decomposed into distal and proximal input correlation contributions
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: engram-pair correlation coefficient

pipeline_steps.technique: Numerical calculation of mutual information between single-neuron activity and distal dendritic input for one- and two-compartment network variants, integrated numerically to generate a figure
pipeline_steps.input_data_type: simulated neuron activation and distal-input distributions
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: mutual information per active neuron (Figure 5B)

papers.title: Sublayer-Specific Coding Dynamics during Spatial Navigation and Learning in Hippocampal Area CA1.

pipeline_steps.technique: Identification of spatially tuned cells via tuning specificity and spatial information

parameters.running_epoch_definition: consecutive forward-locomotion frames >=1 s duration with peak speed >=5 cm/s; epochs separated by <0.5 s merged
parameters.tuning_specificity: magnitude of the spatial tuning vector (1 - circular variance of occupancy-normalized transients); significance via 100,000 shuffles of transient onset times within running frames
parameters.spatial_information: Skaggs spatial information content computed across bin counts N = {2,4,5,8,10,20,25,100}; bias-corrected against 100,000 shuffled-onset null distributions
parameters.classification: cells classified as place cells separately by each metric based on shuffle-derived p-values

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: Ca2+ transient onset times restricted to running epochs
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: classified place cells with tuning specificity and spatial information scores

pipeline_steps.technique: Cross-session remapping analysis: population vector correlation, centroid shift, and tuning curve correlation

parameters.rate_maps: 100 position bins, Gaussian-smoothed (σ = 3 bins), transients per bin normalized by occupancy
parameters.pv_correlation: 1D rate maps of all cells per sublayer stacked into population vectors, all cells included regardless of tuning
parameters.centroid_shift: angle (radians) between spatial tuning vectors across sessions, restricted to place cells by tuning specificity
parameters.tuning_curve_correlation: Pearson correlation between rate maps across sessions, restricted to place cells by spatial information

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: cross-session rate maps and tuning vectors
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: PV correlation, centroid shift, and tuning curve correlation values

pipeline_steps.technique: Deep-vs-superficial task-modulation shuffle analysis (RF vs. GOL)

parameters.shuffle_1: null distribution of delta task modulation from randomizing deep/superficial cell identity within each experiment (100,000 shuffles)
parameters.shuffle_2: null distribution from shuffling RF/GOL experiment identity while preserving each cell's sublayer identity (100,000 shuffles)

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: significance of sublayer difference in task modulation

pipeline_steps.technique: Reward-representation-versus-performance regression and shuffle analysis

parameters.regression: linear regression of GOL task performance (fraction of licks in reward zone) on covariates including day of experiment
parameters.comparison_metric: absolute difference between correlation coefficients (r-values) for the two sublayers
parameters.null_model: null distribution of r-value differences from randomizing cell identity within each experiment (100,000 shuffles)

pipeline_steps.input_data_type: per-cell reward-zone representation strength and behavioral performance
pipeline_steps.output_data_type: regression coefficients and significance of sublayer difference in reward encoding

pipeline_steps.technique: Group-level statistical testing framework

parameters.primary_test: paired two-sample t-test wherever possible to compare population means across animals
parameters.nonparametric_alternative: Mann-Whitney U test when a paired t-test was not applicable
parameters.repeated_measures: ANOVA to compare behavior across sessions and days

pipeline_steps.output_data_type: statistical significance results
